Freshness.description: fresh: inside the freshness window; stale: older than the window; expired: past a provider-supplied quote expiry

InputRowStatus.description: valid rows are queued; duplicate rows repeat an earlier valid domain; invalid rows cannot be queried; ambiguous rows need a decision (see suggestion) and are not queued

suggestion.description: Suggested registrable domain for ambiguous rows

expandedFrom.description: Base name this row was expanded from

text.description: Pasted text, TXT or CSV content

csvColumn.description: CSV header to read; defaults to the first column

presetId.description: Extension preset whose suffixes are added to extensions

text.description: Pasted text, TXT or CSV content

csvColumn.description: CSV header to read; defaults to the first column

presetId.description: Extension preset whose suffixes are added to extensions

domains.description: Unique valid domains in input order

RegistryOutcome.description: no_record means the authoritative registry source returned no registration record. It is not a guarantee that the name can be registered.

source.description: Source establishing the status; null when unknown

scope.description: What the status applies to, e.g. a registry policy

RoutingSource.description: Where the registry destination for this suffix came from

registryId.description: Shared cooldown key for one registry operator or host

destination.description: RDAP base URL or WHOIS host:port actually queried

expiresAt.description: Registry expiry date. A fact, not a drop prediction.

source.description: Null when no source was queried (invalid or unsupported)

reused.description: True when a job reused this observation from cache

matchedName.description: Domain name the source returned, checked against the request

CoverageStatus.description: tested: classifier has fixtures and/or a live validation; discovered: a registry destination is known but classification is untested; unsupported: no usable public registry lookup is known

routing.description: Where the registry destination for this suffix came from

liveValidation.description: Authorized live validation names and results

ProviderId.description: Provider identifier, e.g. porkbun, hostinger, register-si

ProviderKind.description: directory entries come from registry-published registrar lists

CapabilityLevel.description: documented: implemented from official documentation without fixtures; fixture_tested: covered by sanitized fixtures; live_tested: exercised against the real service

source.description: Official documentation URL for this capability

envVar.description: Environment variable that can supply this field

CredentialStorage.description: env: environment variables; session: kept in memory until the backend stops; file: owner-only local credential file

storage.description: env: environment variables; session: kept in memory until the backend stops; file: owner-only local credential file

storageLocation.description: File path when storage is file

ProviderReadiness.description: keyless: only keyless capabilities (links, public catalog) are active; credentials_missing: optional authenticated capabilities need setup

kind.description: dashboard links need an account login

freshness.description: fresh: inside the freshness window; stale: older than the window; expired: past a provider-supplied quote expiry

suffixes.description: Known supported suffixes; null when unknown without a catalog

apiHosts.description: Hosts that receive domain names during exact checks, quotes, transfers or aftermarket lookups

storage.description: session keeps secrets in memory only; file writes the owner-only credential file

ConfirmationStatus.description: Provider-reported state for one exact name at one time

destination.description: API host the name was sent to

PriceKind.description: published: a provider catalog price for the suffix; estimated: derived, e.g. future renewal; exact_quote: provider response for one exact name

PremiumStatus.description: hint: heuristic or catalog-level indication, not a confirmed premium

TaxState.description: unknown tax is never treated as zero

includesYears.description: Registration years included with the transfer; 0 when none, null when unknown

eligibilityVerified.description: False when account or customer eligibility is unknown

icann.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

amount.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

registration.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

renewal.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

destination.description: Purchase handoff for the same provider and purchase path

currency.description: Comparison currency; requires an attributed FX rate
Comparison currency; requires an attributed FX rate

kind.description: published: a provider catalog price for the suffix; estimated: derived, e.g. future renewal; exact_quote: provider response for one exact name

initialCommitment.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

horizonTotal.description: Initial commitment plus current renewal for remaining years. Future renewals are estimates.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

subtotalOnly.description: True when tax or fees are unknown, so the total is a base subtotal

rank.description: Rank among complete comparable rows in the same currency; null when not rankable

freshness.description: fresh: inside the freshness window; stale: older than the window; expired: past a provider-supplied quote expiry

cheapest.description: Cheapest complete comparable row per domain and currency

registration.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

renewal.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

transfer.description: Exact decimal amount as a string

key.description: Comparable series key: provider, scope, path, currency, region, term, promotion

scope.description: Suffix or exact domain the prices apply to

gaps.description: Periods with no observations; never interpolated

namespace.description: Exact identifier type checked, e.g. GitHub user or organization login

reason.description: Why an unsupported service is unsupported

NameCheckOutcome.description: not_found means no public record was returned. It does not mean the name is claimable.

Resolver.description: system uses the OS resolver; cloudflare and google use DNS over HTTPS

data.description: Observed answer, e.g. records, certificate fields or HTTP status

providerId.description: Provider identifier, e.g. porkbun, hostinger, register-si

caveat.description: Listing evidence is not proof of seller authority or final cost

text.description: CSV with domain, registrar, renewalDate, renewalPrice, currency, notes
CSV with domain, registrar, renewalDate, renewalPrice, currency, notes

known.description: Sourced facts, e.g. registry status clientTransferProhibited

TransferOption.description: Read-only comparison; no authorization codes or transfers are handled

ItemState.description: Execution state; the source outcome is separate

unresolved.description: Finished items without a definitive answer (inconclusive, rate limited, blocked, errors)

destinations.description: Every external destination this job may contact

text.description: Original pasted input, kept to restore the scan

parentJobId.description: Job this one retried or rechecked

BestPrice.description: Lowest known first-year registration price among enabled providers; never a confirmed total

subject.description: ASCII domain, or the name for name checks

target.description: Provider, service or diagnostic check id

source.description: Shared source budget key this item used, e.g. registry:verisign or provider:porkbun; null for local work

evidence.description: Evidence observed for this item; other kinds are null or empty

recheck.description: Ignore cached observations and query again
Ignore cached observations and query again

q.description: Substring match on the domain or name

inCollection.description: Only items in (true) or not in (false) any shortlist

outcomes.description: Retry finished items with these outcomes

offers.description: Latest offers per provider and purchase path

providerIds.description: Providers queried for exact-name confirmation and quotes; disclosure is explicit

missedRuns.description: Intervals missed while the backend was stopped, since the last run

value.description: Outcome, status or amount with currency
